firm_data.firm_description: BakerHostetler is a leading law firm that helps clients around the world address their most complex and critical business and regulatory issues. With six core practice groups, the firm has lawyers in offices coast to coast, serving clients across the United States and in more than 100 countries.
notable_facts: Recognized as one of the top firms for client service and quality of legal services

email.subject: AI for Baker & Hostetler — scaling complex practice areas efficiently
email.body:
Hi there,

With 1,000+ lawyers across digital assets, IP, and complex litigation work spanning 100+ countries, Baker & Hostetler faces a unique challenge: maintaining quality and precision at scale while competing on efficiency.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built for law firms managing high-stakes, complex work with lean operations. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on what matters: precision, client trust, and reducing manual work on substantive legal tasks.

Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're expanding to major markets. I'd be happy to stop by your Washington office to show how we're helping firms like yours compete — and win — on both quality and efficiency.

Worth 20 minutes?

Vasu
Lucio
